summary: Verified reported editability/selection/undo-redo/over-budget bug on public preview URL with backend regression and independent desktop+mobile UI automation. Reported issue is not reproducible after fix.

integration_issues.issue: Observed repeated REQUEST FAILED for /__emergent_overlay__/report (net::ERR_ABORTED) during automated sessions; no visible webpack/runtime overlay in app and no user-facing break reproduced.

action_items: No blocking bug fix required for the reported issue; behavior matches requested acceptance criteria.
Optional: investigate emergent overlay report aborts in preview infrastructure logs (non-product path).
critical_code_review_comments: Manual selection is intentionally decoupled from optimizer constraints and remains user-editable via native checkboxes with dedicated recommendation badges.
State/history architecture in useWorkspace/useDraftHistory preserves manual choices across recompute and correctly invalidates solver proof on input edits while allowing pure-selection undo/redo.
manualSelection integer-hundredths arithmetic correctly avoids floating-point phantom over-budget errors (0.10 + 0.20 vs 0.30 validated).
test_credentials: File /app/memory/test_credentials.md exists but contains no credentials; auth not in scope for this request.
seed_data_creation: No persistent seed data introduced. Tests used reset dialog/sample datasets only.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Independent verification completed against user-reported bug scenario: budget 7500 compute -> manual select shopping-2 -> manual 10,500 with 'Over budget by 3,000'; Undo/Redo and Use recommendation behaved correctly; rerun preserved manual choices; input edit invalidated solver; mode histories remained isolated; mobile 390x844 interactions and warning visibility passed.
rca of the issue: Original complaint ('cannot edit/select/undo and over-budget not shown') is not reproducible on current build. Reproduction steps executed exactly on public URL and passed: selectable checkboxes (click + keyboard Space), immediate totals update, explicit over-budget warning, Undo/Redo history for selection and edits, and separate algorithm recommendation labeling. Earlier automation-only failures were due to dirty intermediate state assumptions, not product behavior.
